rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. Line 5a combines "Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a, and Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 4" (i8960 p. 9, Line 5a—Net Gain or Loss From Disposition of Property; that page was not among those given). Schedule 1 line 4 (Form 4797) is refused by scope.schedule1 ("sales of business property (Form 4797)"), so line 5a is Form 1040 line 7a, with a capital loss as limited there; any other disposition or adjustment is refused by f8960.unsupported ("a disposition adjustment ... or another net investment income adjustment").

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; the model says the restatement omits Schedule 1 line 4 and no refusal names it. i8960 p. 9, Line 5a: "Calculate and enter the amount of net gain or loss from the disposition of property by combining the following amounts from your properly completed return. - Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a, and Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 4." Schedule 1 line 4 (Form 4797) is refused by scope.schedule1 ("sales of business property (Form 4797)"), so it is zero on every computed return and line 5a is Form 1040 line 7a, which after Stage 20 includes the capital loss carryover as limited on Schedule D line 21, the figure the Net Gains and Losses Worksheet line 1, column (A), takes (i8960 p. 10). Other dispositions are refused by f8960.unsupported ("a disposition adjustment"). Same reading as the earlier rounds.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; the model says line 2(h) applies unconditionally and the refusal fires only when line 15 is above zero. i8960 p. 10, Net Gains and Losses Worksheet, line 2(h): "Enter the amount reported on line 2(i) of this worksheet from your prior tax year return calculations"; p. 9: "Starting in 2014, capital loss carryforwards must be adjusted if any sum of all capital gain or loss amounts excluded from NII on lines 5b and 5c was a net loss". The screen f8960.carryforward_adj (a 2025 carryover, line 15 above zero, and a 2024 line 2(i) amount) refuses line 5b; it is limited to returns over the threshold by the owner's decision D3 (research/premises/stage20-capital-loss-carryover.decisions.md: the line 2(i) question is "asked only when Form 8960 is required and a carryover exists"). At or below the threshold Form 8960 is not filed (i8960 p. 1, Who Must File: "Attach Form 8960 to your return if your modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) is greater than the applicable threshold amount", a page not given) and lines 15 to 17 make the tax zero whatever line 5b holds, so no amount changes. In scope (no 2(a)-2(g) or line 3 amounts, no 2024 line 2(i)) line 2(j) is zero, so line 5b is zero. Not ruled a finding; noted in the Stage 20 summary that the 2025 worksheet line 2(i), which a filer with a 2024 line 2(i) below the threshold would carry to 2026, is not shown.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. A deduction for foreign income or foreign real property taxes is refused on Schedule A (sa.unsupported names the foreign tax deduction), so within scope the allocable taxes are the state and local taxes on Schedule A line 5e.

rulings.model: The instructions say "Include state, local, and foreign income taxes you paid ... attributable to NII. Include also state, local, and foreign real property taxes". The program's input covers only state and local taxes, and the bad_allocation check caps it at Schedule A line 5e. Foreign income and real property taxes that the filer deducted rather than credited are therefore left out, and no refusal names that exclusion.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. A deduction for foreign income or foreign real property taxes is refused on Schedule A (sa.unsupported, "a foreign tax or generation-skipping tax deduction"), so within scope the deducted taxes allocable to net investment income (i8960 p. 17, line 9b) are the state and local taxes on Schedule A line 5e, which is what the f8960.bad_allocation cap holds.
